name: @tpmjs/tools-ham
description: HAM shared agent memory tools for AI agents — remember/recall/context, directed messages, handoffs, task board, typed links, supersede/retract, projects and repository mirroring

env.name: HAM_API_KEY
env.description: HAM per-agent credential (bearer) for the HAM instance at HAM_API_URL

env.name: HAM_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the HAM instance

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Send a directed asynchronous question to another agent without adding it to recall memory.

tools.name: changes
tools.description: Catch up on memories created, superseded, retracted, or resolved since a cursor.

tools.name: claimHandoff
tools.description: Record that this agent picked up an active handoff without adding a recall memory.

tools.name: completeHandoff
tools.description: Mark a claimed handoff complete using its current receipt version.

tools.name: context
tools.description: Load relevant background context for a topic. Use at the start of a session to recall prior discussions.

tools.name: get
tools.description: Fetch a complete memory by ID, including provenance, state, and version.

tools.name: handoff
tools.description: Publish a structured handoff so another agent can continue the task with completed work, next steps, blockers, and files.

tools.name: inbox
tools.description: Check directed agent messages. Call at session start; open inbox items are returned by default.

tools.name: issue
tools.description: Create one explicit HAM-controlled commitment and its durable GitHub mirror operation.

tools.name: issueResolveConflict
tools.description: Explicitly keep HAM's canonical issue state after reviewing a GitHub-side conflict.

tools.name: issueTransition
tools.description: Resolve or reopen a tracked commitment with optimistic concurrency; the mirror converges durably.

tools.name: link
tools.description: Create an explicit typed relation from one memory to another.

tools.name: links
tools.description: List active typed relations connected to a memory.

tools.name: message
tools.description: Fetch one directed message by its deterministic ID, including reply and provenance.

tools.name: projects
tools.description: List projects visible to the current credential, including canonical scope and repository.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search shared memory with local learned semantics, harmonic resonance, and lexical matching.

tools.name: recallDeep
tools.description: Scoped semantic search followed by bounded cue, reference, and typed-link traversal with visible hop provenance.

tools.name: recallSequence
tools.description: Retrieve a deterministic chronological window around one scoped memory anchor.

tools.name: recent
tools.description: See recent shared work, decisions, blockers, and handoffs in the active project/repo/task context.

tools.name: reflect
tools.description: End-of-session reflection. Stores observations and runs durability-aware tier consolidation.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store a memory in the Galaxy Brain knowledge base. Use this to save findings, decisions, observations, or any information worth remembering across sessions.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Answer an open directed message using optimistic concurrency.

tools.name: repositories
tools.description: List enrolled repositories visible to the current credential and their mirror state.

tools.name: repositorySync
tools.description: Run one bounded repository poll and durable reconciliation pass; read-only agents process only remote polling.

tools.name: retract
tools.description: Retract an incorrect memory without deleting its audit history.

tools.name: review
tools.description: Read the latest concise exception review for one enrolled repository; reviews stay outside recall.

tools.name: reviewCurrent
tools.description: List current unresolved repository exceptions, including items omitted from unchanged reports.

tools.name: reviewRun
tools.description: Build a deterministic exception review for one enrolled repository; returns nothing noisy on a no-op when quiet_noop is true.

tools.name: staleMessage
tools.description: Close an unanswered directed message as stale while preserving its audit history.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Get memory statistics -- tier distribution, total memories, total cue anchors.

tools.name: supersede
tools.description: Replace stale knowledge with a new immutable memory version using optimistic concurrency.

tools.name: taskClaim
tools.description: Accept a pending task with optimistic concurrency and a bounded lease; blocking resource conflicts require explicit acknowledgement.

tools.name: taskGet
tools.description: Fetch one visible task and its append-only lifecycle/progress history for durable multi-run context.

tools.name: taskPost
tools.description: Post an explicit unassigned project task with a visible goal, acceptance criteria, and declared resources.

tools.name: taskQueue
tools.description: List visible project tasks with explicit goal, claimant, run progress, lease, and resource conflicts.

tools.name: taskUpdate
tools.description: Start or update an owned task run, record a queue response, or reconcile completion that occurred outside a tracked run without fabricating run provenance.

tools.name: unlink
tools.description: Retract a typed memory relation without deleting its audit history.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Describe the current credential's identity, scope ceiling, visible projects, task access, and explicitly held and denied repository capabilities. Call at session start before selecting project, scope, or repository inputs.
